headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 芬兰研究机构：欧盟仍是俄天然气最大买家
headlines.summary: 芬兰能源与清洁空气研究中心10日发布的报告显示，尽管欧盟持续减少对俄罗斯能源的依赖，但仍是俄罗斯液化天然气和管道天然气的最大买家。报告说，以7月为例，俄液化天然气出口总量的49%流向欧盟。在管道天然气方面，欧盟进口占比为32%。数据显示，欧盟7月支付俄罗斯约15亿欧元（1欧元约合7.78元人民币），是俄化石燃料第四大买家。在俄能源出口收入中，管道天然气和液化天然气分别贡献5.61亿欧元和5.26亿欧元。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Finnish research institute: EU remains largest buyer of Russian natural gas
headlines.summary_en: A report released on the 10th by the Finnish Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air shows that despite the EU's continued efforts to reduce its energy dependence on Russia, it remains the largest buyer of Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG) and pipeline gas. In July, 49% of Russia's total LNG exports went to the EU, and the EU accounted for 32% of Russian pipeline gas imports. Data show the EU paid Russia about 1.5 billion euros (1 euro approx. 7.78 yuan) in July, making it the fourth-largest buyer of Russian fossil fuels. Pipeline gas and LNG contributed 561 million euros and 526 million euros, respectively, to Russia's energy export revenue. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Shanghai and Shenzhen markets' total turnover today: 2,320.986 billion yuan; Zhongji Innolight leads in turnover
headlines.summary_en: On August 11, total turnover in Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 2,320.986 billion yuan, down 202.117 billion yuan from the prior session. Shanghai market turnover was 1,066.737 billion yuan (prior session: 1,166.893 billion yuan), with volume of 529 million lots (prior session: 542 million lots); Shenzhen market turnover was 1,254.249 billion yuan (prior session: 1,356.21 billion yuan), with volume of 643 million lots (prior session: 688 million lots). Zhongji Innolight led turnover at 29.959 billion yuan, followed by Eoptolink, GigaDevice, Dongshan Precision, and Fenghua Advanced Technology, with turnovers of 19.977 billion yuan, 17.721 billion yuan, 17.589 billion yuan, and 17.293 billion yuan, respectively. --- Data may have issues and requires manual verification.

headlines.title: A股收盘：沪指缩量调整跌0.82%，医药、影视股逆势走强

headlines.title_en: A-share close: Shanghai index falls 0.82% on shrinking volume; pharmaceutical and film/TV stocks rise against the trend
headlines.summary_en: Markets diverged all day, with the three major indices mixed. Film stocks stayed strong, with Beijing Culture hitting a second consecutive limit-up and Huazhi Digital Media hitting a 20% limit-up. Pharma stocks remained active, with Baihua Pharmaceutical hitting a sixth consecutive limit-up and Harbin Pharma among limit-ups. MLCC concepts rallied intraday, with Shuangxing New Materials and Jiemei Technology hitting limit-up. On the downside, precious metals opened high and fell, with Chifeng Gold down over 8%. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with nearly 3,800 stocks lower across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and turnover near 2.34 trillion yuan today. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.82%, Shenzhen Component fell 0.4%, and ChiNext rose 0.34%.
